prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: an aligned expression frame for an existing 2D avatar animation.
Image 1 is the canonical avatar and the only identity, style, pose, lighting, and framing authority.
Close both eyelids naturally for one blink. Change only the eyelid regions; preserve mouth and head pose, and preserve the glasses exactly.
Preserve the complete original image outside the specified facial region. Keep canvas dimensions, transparent alpha, head position and size, silhouette, hair, eyebrows, glasses, nose, ears, neck, clothing, shoulders, lighting, colors, texture, and crop unchanged. No camera movement, recentering, rescaling, head tilt, retouching, or redesign. This must be directly swappable with Image 1 without a visible jump. Preserve actual transparency. No labels, text, border, or watermark.
